questions.question: What React pattern optimizes expensive computations?
questions.explanation: useMemo caches computed values.

questions.question: What React hook prevents unnecessary function recreations?
questions.explanation: useCallback memoizes function references.

questions.question: What Angular feature detects and propagates changes?
questions.explanation: Change detection updates the view when data changes.

questions.question: What Vue feature provides centralized state management?
questions.explanation: Vuex manages global application state.

questions.question: What React pattern manages complex state logic?
questions.explanation: useReducer handles state transitions with actions.

questions.question: What Angular pattern observes asynchronous data?
questions.explanation: Observables handle async data streams.

questions.question: What Vue API creates reactive references?
questions.explanation: ref makes primitive values reactive.

questions.question: What Vue API creates reactive objects?
questions.explanation: reactive makes objects deeply reactive.

questions.question: What React pattern prevents component rerenders?
questions.explanation: React.memo memoizes components.

questions.question: What Angular module enables routing?
questions.explanation: RouterModule provides navigation capabilities.

questions.question: What React hook marks state updates as non-urgent transitions?
questions.explanation: useTransition defers non-blocking updates.

questions.question: What pattern extracts reusable stateful logic into functions starting with "use"?
questions.explanation: Custom hooks share logic between components.

questions.question: What Vue 3 API organizes reactive logic inside setup()?
questions.explanation: The Composition API replaces options-based organization.

questions.question: What Next.js rendering mode pre-renders pages at build time?
questions.explanation: SSG generates HTML during the build.

questions.question: What Next.js feature revalidates static pages after deployment?
questions.explanation: ISR updates static pages on a schedule or demand.

questions.question: After state changes, React diffs the new virtual DOM against the previous one to compute minimal real-DOM updates. What is this process called?
questions.explanation: Reconciliation is React's diffing algorithm that determines the smallest set of DOM mutations needed.

questions.question: A React developer fetches order data inside a hook that runs after render and can clean up on unmount. Which hook is it?
questions.explanation: useEffect runs side effects after render; its returned function acts as the cleanup.

questions.question: A Vue form uses one directive so an input and its data property stay synchronized both ways. Which directive?
questions.explanation: v-model creates two-way binding on form inputs, combining :value and @input.

questions.question: An Angular component receives HttpClient through its constructor instead of instantiating it. Which design pattern supplies the service?
questions.explanation: Angular's injector supplies declared dependencies, decoupling components from concrete instantiation.

questions.question: Cart state must be readable by many nested components without prop drilling, so the developer wraps the app in a provider. Which React feature is this?
questions.explanation: React Context broadcasts values to descendant consumers via a Provider, avoiding prop drilling.
